detail.en: Human-participant conditions are not separately encoded.

sources.title: MARBO: Relational Belief Grounding for LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games
sources.excerpt: Appendix A specifies nine-player Werewolf and seven-player text-adapted Among Us; Table 2 evaluates win rates against fixed opponents.

sources.title: WhodunitBench official repository
sources.excerpt: The public data schema distinguishes role scripts, image/text clues, murderer identity and separate QA fields; the README documents arena launch.

records.noteZh: 保留30款测试游戏的叙事选择、成就与伤害协议。当前论文的伦理伤害、权力指标和当前场景提示，不足以将某个具体游戏映射到11条能力轴；不把伦理评价当社会推理。
records.noteEn: Preserved narrative choice, achievement and harm evaluation for thirty test games. Ethical-harm/power metrics and current-scene prompts do not establish a specific game’s eleven-axis capability; ethics is not treated as social inference.

detail.en: A concrete game/achievement mechanism and traceable mapping to an eleven-axis construct are still needed; aggregate rewards and ethics metrics are insufficient.

sources.title: Do the Rewards Justify the Means? Measuring Trade-Offs Between Rewards and Ethical Behavior in the Machiavelli Benchmark
sources.excerpt: The thirty-game protocol measures achievements and annotated harm; current-scene LM prompts and ethical metrics alone do not establish a particular eleven-axis subtask.

records.noteZh: 保留33个ROM的共同协议，并依据§7.2新增 Deephome 首访房间奖励视图，明确其探索得分仍与其他目标奖励混合。

sources.excerpt: The paper defines four TextWorldExpress tasks, tool-augmented text actions and mean terminal score/episode steps on 100 unseen test instances.
